articles.title: Drake’s 40th birthday gets personal with a special onstage moment alongside his dad
articles.summary: Drake’s 40th birthday celebration delivered plenty of luxury, surprise performances and celebrity guests, but one of the night’s most memorable moments came when the Canadian rapper took the stage alongside his father, Dennis Graham. The milestone celebration brought Drake together with family and friends in New York City, where the rapper marked his birthday with an extravagant party featuring lavish gifts, cash prizes and a performance by the Backstreet Boys. Sharing the spotlight with his dad added a personal touch to an evening otherwise defined by high-end entertainment. Drake turned 40 on Saturday, Oct. 24, and began the festivities Friday night at Casa Cipriani in Manhattan. An attendee told PEOPLE that the event was “so elegant, over the top and expensive,” describing a lavishly decorated venue and a guest list of approximately 400 people.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes shares a sweet glimpse of her kids’ big-machine adventure in Kansas City
articles.summary: Brittany Mahomes traded the football field for a hands-on adventure with her three children this weekend, taking Sterling Skye, Patrick “Bronze” Lavon Mahomes III and Golden Raye Mahomes to Dozer Day in Kansas City, Missouri. The wife of Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes shared lovely photos from the family outing on her Instagram Stories, offering a glimpse of the children enjoying an immersive experience built around some of the biggest machines in the construction industry. Dozer Day gives children the opportunity to get behind the wheel of heavy equipment, explore construction machinery up close and discover how the industry works. It was a chance for the Mahomes kids to trade their usual routine for an exciting day of hands-on exploration. The event is designed to combine family fun with education, introducing children to construction careers and giving them opportunities to connect with employers and learn about potential paths into the industry.

articles.title: Glen Powell goes wild as Texas upsets No. 7 Ole Miss after two straight losses
articles.summary: Glen Powell had every reason to celebrate. After watching his beloved Texas Longhorns endure two consecutive losses, the Hollywood star finally got the moment he had been waiting for Saturday night — and he made sure to share it with the fans. Powell erupted with joy as Texas defeated No. 7 Ole Miss 34-27 at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium, embracing Longhorns supporters along the sideline as the home crowd celebrated a much-needed victory. The actor, a regular presence at Texas games, was on hand as the Longhorns delivered one of their most consequential performances of the season in front of 104,306 fans. The win gave Texas its second conference victory and moved the Longhorns to 5-2 overall and 2-2 in SEC play. More importantly, it offered a response after consecutive defeats and gave the team momentum heading into the final stretch of the regular season.

But when the ball went up on Denver’s home-opening night, friendship gave way to competition, and the Nuggets delivered a comeback for the ages. Denver overcame a 22-point second-half deficit to defeat the New Orleans Pelicans 141-135 in overtime, turning a night of reunions into a celebration of resilience.
